title: 📱 Remember Snake? I made a 2-player version with local and online multiplayer. Looking for feedback!
author: toygun1725
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I made a multiplayer version of the classic Snake game with both **local and online PvP**.

🐍 Play on the same device with a friend (no Wi-Fi needed)  
🌎 Play online against other players in real-time  
⚡ Multiple game modes, from classic Snake to fast-paced competitive matches  
🏆 Includes unique modes like Fast Competitive, Adventure, and Self Area 51, each offering a different challenge and play style

I'm currently looking for players to test the controls, matchmaking, and overall experience. If you have a few minutes, I'd love to hear your honest feedback!

Play in browser: [https://2playersnake.com/](https://2playersnake.com/)Android: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.twoplayersnake.app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.twoplayersnake.app)

Thanks for supporting indie developers! 🐍❤️
